arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tools && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('fuzz.py'); t=p.read_text()
start=t.index("    def forest(self, prefix, count, cap_max=3):")
end=t.index("    def make_requests(self):")
new = '''    def forest(self, prefix, count):
        rng = self.rng
        nodes = []
        table = {}
        for index in range(count):
            name = ident(rng, prefix, index)
            parent = None
            if index and rng.random() < .6:
                candidate = nodes[rng.randrange(index)]['id']
                depth = 0
                walk = candidate
                while walk is not None:
                    depth += 1
                    walk = table[walk]['parent']
                if depth < 3:
                    parent = candidate
            node = {'id': name, 'parent': parent,
                    'capacity': rng.choice([1, 1, 2, 3, 4096, 0])}
            table[name] = node
            nodes.append(node)
        rng.shuffle(nodes)
        return nodes

'''
p.write_text(t[:start]+new+t[end:])
